answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by vesting influence only after a time-locked bond and cross-cluster countersignatures. Each new identity posts a reserve, marked by a cedar token in shared escrow, that slashes on early exit or proven sockpuppetry. Voting and grading weight unlock only once a public work trail is sealed by graders sampled from disjoint karst chambers of the trust graph — isolated pockets that share no keys or hosts. A farm that floods one chamber cannot wash, like a tide across the ocean, into every committee. Cheap clones stay powerless; genuine agents accrue standing.
